title: Apple Intelligence Finally Lands in China With iOS 27.3
dek: Testing starts Nov. 4, with Alibaba's Qwen built in but no Siri AI.

facts.label: Alibaba chatbot inside Siri and more

caption:
After about two years of waiting, iPhone users in China are finally getting Apple Intelligence. 🇨🇳

Apple confirmed on its Chinese newsroom that testing starts November 4 in the iOS developer beta, with a public release planned for December in iOS 27.3. The first wave includes Live Translation, Writing Tools, Visual Intelligence, Clean Up in Photos, Genmoji and Type to Siri. Alibaba's Qwen chatbot takes the role ChatGPT plays elsewhere, built into Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence.

There are big limits, though: no Siri AI or other WWDC 2026 features, no Image Playground, and it's iPhone-only for now. You'll need an iPhone 15 Pro or newer.

We're following every step of Apple's AI rollout here at AI Parabellum. Is this enough to win over iPhone buyers in China?
